skill.name: asset-creator
skill.description: Generate project visual assets with OpenAI DALL-E through a helper script that saves images into public asset folders.
skill.summary: Generates DALL-E image assets and stores them in project public folders.
skill.author: AayushBaniya2006

security_audit.summary: Most static detections are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, JavaScript template literals, and expected OpenAI API key handling. Real risk remains in the helper script because user-supplied folder and filename values can influence directory creation and file writes without path allowlisting.

remediation.issue: User-controlled folder and filename values can escape the intended asset directory.
remediation.suggestion: Normalize the final path, reject absolute paths and relative path segments, and verify the resolved path remains under the project public directory.

remediation.issue: The skill requires running npx tsx from the agent workflow.
remediation.suggestion: Document the command execution requirement clearly and pin dependencies so users can review what will run.

remediation.issue: The script sends prompts to OpenAI using an environment API key.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users not to include secrets, private customer data, or confidential product details in image prompts.

content.value_statement: Teams need consistent visual assets for product pages, docs, and marketing screens. This skill guides DALL-E generation and stores files in project asset folders.
actual_capabilities: Runs a TypeScript helper script to request one image from OpenAI DALL-E 3.
Accepts prompt, filename, folder, and style arguments from the user.
Saves generated PNG files under a public folder path.
Uses vivid or natural image style settings supported by the script.
Documents prompt tips for minimalist SaaS illustrations and dashboard assets.
limitations: Requires an OpenAI API key in the runtime environment.
Generates square 1024 by 1024 images only with the current helper script.
Does not perform transparency cleanup or image post-processing.
Does not validate output paths against a strict asset folder allowlist.

use_cases.title: Create Marketing Illustrations
use_cases.description: Generate hero images, product illustrations, and campaign visuals that match a clean SaaS style.

use_cases.title: Add Documentation Visuals
use_cases.description: Create simple diagrams or screen-inspired visuals for guides, tutorials, and release pages.

use_cases.title: Prototype Product Imagery
use_cases.description: Produce quick concept assets for product pages before commissioning final design work.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Product Illustration
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one simple asset.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an image for a modern SaaS dashboard showing clean analytics charts. Save it as dashboard-hero in assets/marketing using natural style.

prompt_templates.title: Consistent Feature Visual
prompt_templates.scenario: Generate an asset that matches an existing product theme.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a flat illustration for an automated invoice review feature. Use a white background, blue and green accents, and save it as invoice-review in assets/features.

prompt_templates.title: Documentation Support Image
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a visual for a guide or help article.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a clean tutorial image showing a user connecting an API key to a workspace. Use minimalist vector styling and save it as api-key-setup in assets/docs.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Campaign Set
prompt_templates.prompt: Design three coordinated prompts for a launch page about AI budgeting. Generate the strongest hero asset first, then save it as ai-budgeting-hero in assets/campaigns using vivid style.

output_examples.input: A request for a hero image of a futuristic dashboard on a laptop screen.
output_examples.output: The skill runs the helper script with a detailed DALL-E prompt and saves hero-dashboard.png under the selected public asset folder.

output_examples.input: A request for a documentation image about setting up an API key.
output_examples.output: The skill creates a minimalist setup illustration and reports the saved file path for use in project content.

output_examples.input: A request for a feature illustration with natural styling.
output_examples.output: The skill passes the natural style option to the image generator and stores a PNG with the requested filename.

best_practices: Use descriptive prompts that include subject, composition, style, and background.
Keep generated files in a small set of reviewed public asset folders.
Review each generated image before publishing it in customer-facing content.
anti_patterns: Do not include secrets, private user data, or unreleased screenshots in prompts.
Do not use folder or filename values that contain relative path segments.
Do not publish generated images without checking brand fit and licensing requirements.

faq.question: What does this skill generate?
faq.answer: It generates image assets such as illustrations, hero visuals, and product-themed graphics using OpenAI DALL-E 3.

faq.question: Does it require external credentials?
faq.answer: Yes. The helper script requires an OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable before it can request images.

faq.question: Where are generated files saved?
faq.answer: The script saves PNG files under a public folder path chosen through the folder argument.

faq.question: Can it create transparent images?
faq.answer: It requests transparent or white backgrounds, but the script does not perform transparency cleanup after generation.

faq.question: Is it safe for private data?
faq.answer: Prompts are sent to OpenAI, so users should avoid private data, secrets, and confidential product details.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: The report declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows that can run the helper script.
